defs.def: a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, an office building, a doctor's surgery, etc. 接待员

ex.s: Talk about a visit to a historic tourist destination 1 Backpacker Paul is talking to a receptionist at an international youth hostel in Pingyao, China.
ex.t: 谈论参观一个历史旅游目的地 1 背包客保罗正在和中国平遥一家国际青年旅舍的前台交谈。

ex.s: Lawyers, teachers, librarians, drivers, and receptionists may find their jobs replaced by AI in the future.
ex.t: 律师、教师、图书管理员、司机和接待员可能会发现他们的工作在未来被人工智能所取代。

ex.s: Send your CV and cover letter to: receptionist@FAFSC.com (FYI: Applications can also be made on paper or disk.) 1 Keep the parking area clean, guide new guests to the reception area, etc.
ex.t: 将你的简历和求职信发送至：receptionist@FAFSC.com （仅供参考：也可通过纸质或磁盘提交申请。）1 保持停车区域清洁，引导新客人到接待区等。

ex.s: Whether we are scientists, lawyers, doctors, public servants, consultants, clerks, receptionists or butchers, we all make our respective contributions.
ex.t: 无论我们是科学家、律师、医生、公务员、顾问、职员、接待员还是屠夫，我们都在做出各自的贡献。
